title: 第9章 天使投资人带不动的天命之子第10章 好戏落幕演员们该退场了
lines: 紫云宗中。
“听说了吗？前几日紫云山脉爆发了大战，紫云矿脉被毁于一旦，我们修炼赖以生存的灵石更是被摧毁殆尽！”
“什么？！这怎可能？究竟是什么层次的攻击才能够摧毁那么大范围的矿脉？我不相信，我不相信。”
“你不相信又有什么用？据说罪魁祸首已经伏诛，好像是我紫云宗的外门弟子。”
“你在搞笑吧？外门弟子？就凭那些普遍炼皮境，最多炼骨境的家伙？想要摧毁紫云矿脉？你是在搞笑吧？”
“不是啊……那个外门弟子是炼血境的修为，而且他返回路上一直在叫嚷着，说什么自己斩杀了紫雷狂狮，是宗门的大功臣，宗门不能这么对他之类的……”
“快，快，我想去看看，这年头疯子可不多见了！”
无数弟子议论纷纷，无不被这个消息震惊。
与此同时。
紫云宗大殿之中。
一众高层面色难看至极。
“宗主，你说紫云矿脉被摧毁了？可是这怎么可能呢？那里就算是炼虚境强者大战应该也很难影响到才是啊……”
一名须发皆白的老者不由发出疑问。
“我本来与那紫雷狂狮交手正酣，忽然之间钻出来了一个黑袍人，黑袍人身上的气息波动非常的剧烈，忽而能达到合体，忽而又只有炼血境，极为诡异。”
“他出手偷袭了我和紫雷狂狮，使我二人都身受重伤，若非客卿长老伸出援助之手，我恐怕就会陨落当场了。”
风云韵一副悲凄的模样，看上去颇为痛心疾首。
众人齐齐看向坐在一旁怡然自得的顾云，这位公子年轻俊朗，但是一身实力简直深不可测，这让一众紫云宗高层都不敢妄议。
此刻男人眼神微微眯起，似乎对于在场的事情没有丝毫在意。
“合体境高手？”老者眉头紧锁：“这等强者为什么会出现在我紫云州境内？”
紫云州乃是苍玄界陆地八大王州之一，紫云宗是其中的霸主级势力，只因有一位合体境的老祖坐镇，只可惜……老祖如今已经几乎陷入死寂之中，紫云宗也逐渐落寞，沦落为八大王州的最弱势力。
如今忽地有一名陌生的合体强者介入，这也让在场的所有长老都心绪不宁。
“会不会是其他王州的修士出手？”一名长老不由担心问道。
“无妨，罪犯我们已经缉拿归案了，不妨我们就在此审核上一审！”
风云韵语气坚定开口。
实则内心很是无奈，紫云矿脉其实是因为顾云那一掌才毁灭的，如今却要栽赃他人，她心中微微有些不忍。
但这都是主人的命令，她必须照做。
而且顾云也从指甲缝里漏了许多补偿，价值远超那紫云矿脉，紫云山脉三大妖王也全都被顾云一巴掌拍死。
从此之后紫云宗在紫云州界内将再无敌手，未来的发展可谓是顺风顺水。
所以于情于理，她都愿意演这一场戏。
老者只得颔首同意。
“那就将那人带上来吧。”
伴随风灵韵森冷话语落下。
一个男子被押了上来。
“唔，唔！！”林萧疯狂摆动身子，想要挣脱那些执法弟子。
面对那些执法弟子，他一直在强调自己绝对没有破坏紫云矿脉，但是那些杀红了眼的弟子哪里听得进他的解释？
一想到以后的修炼路途很有可能就会因此断绝，这些家伙就像是打了鸡血一般，智商清零，勇气翻倍。
还真将林萧抓捕归案。
在见到此人真面目之时。
老者震惊开口：“怎么会是你？”
“唔唔，海老，你帮帮我，我也不知道为什么紫云矿脉被摧毁了啊，这件事情绝对和我没有关系！”
林萧就好像抓住了救命稻草一般，急忙道。
顾云的眸子微微一抬。
【姓名：海殇人】
content_en:
Ziyun Sect.
"Have you heard? A war broke out in the Ziyun Mountains a few days ago. The Ziyun mineral veins were destroyed, and the spiritual stones that we rely on for our cultivation were completely destroyed!"
"What?! How is this possible? What level of attack can destroy such a large area of mineral veins? I don't believe it, I don't believe it."
"What's the point if you don't believe it? It's said that the culprit has been killed. He seems to be an outer disciple of my Ziyun Sect."
"Are you kidding me? Outer disciples? Just those guys who are generally in the skin refining realm and most in the bone refining realm? Want to destroy the Ziyun Mine? Are you kidding me?"
"No...that outer disciple is at the Blood Refining Realm, and he kept shouting on the way back, saying that he killed the Purple Thunder Lion and was a great contributor to the sect. The sect cannot treat him like this..."
"Quick, quick, I want to take a look. There are not many crazy people these days!"
Countless disciples were talking about it, and they were all shocked by the news.
at the same time.
In the main hall of Ziyun Sect.
The faces of all the high-level people were extremely ugly.
"Sect Master, you said that the Ziyun Mineral Veins have been destroyed? But how is this possible? Even the battle between the Void Refining Realm experts there should be difficult to affect..."
An old man with white beard and hair couldn't help but ask questions.
"I was in the middle of a fight with the purple thunder lion, and suddenly a black-robed man emerged. The aura of the black-robed man's body fluctuated very violently. He could suddenly reach the merged state, and sometimes he could only be in the blood refining state. It was extremely weird."
"He made a sneak attack on me and the Purple Thunder Lion, causing both of us to be seriously injured. If Elder Keqing hadn't extended a helping hand, I would have died on the spot."
Feng Yunyun looked sad, looking quite heartbroken.
Everyone looked at Gu Yun, who was sitting beside him contentedly. This young master was young and handsome, but his strength was simply unfathomable, which made the senior officials of Ziyun Sect not dare to make any unreasonable comments.
At this moment, the man's eyes narrowed slightly, as if he didn't care at all about what was going on.
"A master of the Fusion Realm?" The old man frowned: "Why do such powerful people appear in our Ziyun Prefecture?"
Ziyun State is one of the eight kingdoms in Cangxuan Realm, and Ziyun Sect is the dominant force among them, just because there is an ancestor of the Fusion Realm sitting in charge. Unfortunately...the ancestor has almost fallen into deathly silence, and Ziyun Sect has gradually become lonely and has become the weakest force in the eight kingdoms.
Now, a strange powerful fusion man suddenly intervened, which also made all the elders present feel uneasy.
"Could it be the monks from other Wangzhous who took action?" An elder asked worriedly.
"It doesn't matter, we have arrested the criminal, so we might as well conduct the first trial here!"
Fengyun Yun spoke firmly.
In fact, she felt very helpless inside. The Ziyun Mine was actually destroyed because of Gu Yun's palm, but now she wanted to frame others, and she felt a little intolerable.
But these are the master's orders, and she must obey them.
Moreover, Gu Yun also leaked a lot of compensation from under his fingernails, which was worth far more than the Ziyun mineral vein. All three demon kings in the Ziyun Mountain Range were slapped to death by Gu Yun.
From now on, Ziyun Sect will no longer have any rivals in Ziyun State, and its future development can be described as smooth.
Therefore, she was willing to act in this scene both emotionally and rationally.
The old man could only nod in agreement.
"Then bring that person up."
The cold words fell with the wind and rhyme.
A man was escorted up.
"Uh, uh!!" Lin Xiao swung his body wildly, trying to break away from the law enforcement disciples.
In the face of the law enforcement disciples, he had been emphasizing that he had absolutely not destroyed the Ziyun Mine veins, but how could those jealous disciples listen to his explanation?
When they think about the possibility that their future cultivation path will be cut off due to this, these guys are like being given a shot of chicken blood, their IQs are cleared and their courage is doubled.
Lin Xiao was really arrested and brought to justice.
"Lin Xiao?!!"
When seeing this person's true face.
The old man was shocked and said: "How could it be you?"
"Hmm, Ebi, please help me. I don't know why the Ziyun Mine was destroyed. This matter has absolutely nothing to do with me!"
Lin Xiao said hurriedly as if he had grasped a life-saving straw.
Gu Yun's eyes raised slightly.
[Name: Haishangren]
【Age: 264】
